title: Thirty-two Montana deployment-project IDs now join to named subgrantees
summary: The project registry preserves all 32 deployment-project IDs and joins every row to a named subgrantee through the official UEI, including one CAI-only project with zero BSL location rows. Denominator: All 32 Final Proposal deployment-project rows joined to the 19-row subgrantee register.
key_findings: Finding: The project registry preserves all 32 deployment-project IDs and joins every row to a named subgrantee through the official UEI, including one CAI-only project with zero BSL location rows.
Denominator: All 32 Final Proposal deployment-project rows joined to the 19-row subgrantee register.
Boundary: Project inclusion is an approved-proposal baseline, not construction start.
Boundary: A zero-BSL project can still carry CAI rows and must not be dropped.
Boundary: Project names are preserved as source labels rather than standardized operating brands.
Next action: Use project ID plus UEI as the mandatory key for future agreement, construction, service, testing, adoption, and closeout observations.
